title: Rainbow with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <style>
      .rainbow { fill: none; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-width: 7; }
    </style>
  </defs>
  <!-- Rainbow arcs, from outer to inner -->
  <path class="rainbow" d="M 12 78 A 38 38 0 0 1 88 78" stroke="#FF3B3B" />
  <path class="rainbow" d="M 19 78 A 31 31 0 0 1 81 78" stroke="#FF9A1F" />
  <path class="rainbow" d="M 26 78 A 24 24 0 0 1 74 78" stroke="#FFE42B" />
  <path class="rainbow" d="M 33 78 A 17 17 0 0 1 67 78" stroke="#59D95B" />
  <path class="rainbow" d="M 40 78 A 10 10 0 0 1 60 78" stroke="#3DB7FF" />
  <!-- Cloud puffs at both ends -->
  <g fill="#9EE7FF">
    <circle cx="12" cy="78" r="9" />
    <circle cx="22" cy="76" r="7" />
    <circle cx="7" cy="75" r="7" />
    <circle cx="88" cy="78" r="9" />
    <circle cx="78" cy="76" r="7" />
    <circle cx="93" cy="75" r="7" />
  </g>
  <!-- Cloud highlights -->
  <g fill="#D6F6FF">
    <circle cx="12" cy="76" r="5" />
    <circle cx="88" cy="76" r="5" />
  </g>
  <!-- Smiling face on the rainbow -->
  <!-- Eyes -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="54" r="5" fill="#2E2B5E" />
  <circle cx="60" cy="54" r="5" fill="#2E2B5E" />
  <circle cx="42" cy="52" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF" />
  <circle cx="62" cy="52" r="2" fill="#FFFFFF" />
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M 38 63 Q 50 74 62 63" fill="none" stroke="#2E2B5E" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round" />
  <!-- Rosy cheeks -->
  <circle cx="32" cy="62" r="4" fill="#FF8FB1" opacity="0.8" />
  <circle cx="68" cy="62" r="4" fill="#FF8FB1" opacity="0.8" />
</svg>
